gates.evidence: At thumbnail and native scale the heroine's prop reads immediately as one straight double-edged sword, with a pointed steel blade, transverse guard, wrapped grip, and pommel.
The native crop shows one continuous aligned blade, guard, grip, and pommel; the decorative guard remains a minor ornament rather than a structural break.
At both scales the heroine herself visibly encloses the grip in her right hand and keeps the complete sword upright beside her body; it is not transferred, hidden, or wall-mounted.
The native hand crop shows a coherent thumb, four curled fingers, knuckles, palm, and aligned wrist wrapping the leather grip without severe fusion or impossible articulation.
